_notice: ENTIRELY SYNTHETIC EXAMPLES for illustrating the extraction patterns. Not a real paper, no real facts, no formal test output. The DOI 10.0000/EXAMPLE.* is a reserved/fictional identifier. Every quote is a substring of the '_synthetic_text' key so you can reproduce the validator run.
_synthetic_text: In HEK293T cells, kinase X increased the phosphorylation of Y (Fig. 2B). Drug A and Drug B both reduced tumor growth in mice. Drug C increased IL-6 secretion and decreased IL-10 secretion in macrophages, which led to a pro-inflammatory phenotype. Treatment with 10 mg/kg of drug D improved survival compared with vehicle. Kinase Z did not reduce the phosphorylation of Y. The median survival was 18 days in the treated group and 9 days in the control group. Serum biomarker B was positively associated with disease severity but was not found to cause it. Protein P is a member of the kinase K family and binds protein Q. The authors did not report the sample size for cohort 3.
